title: The Fairy Garden Surprise

pages.title: A tiny garden
pages.caption: Lila finds a drooping flower.
pages.speech: Lila the fairy found a flower with a drooping head. Hello, little flower, she whispered. What would help you feel better today?
pages.art: Tiny fairy Lila with brown skin dark curly bob mint dress translucent wings beside drooping pink flower in lush garden.

pages.title: Look at the soil
pages.caption: The soil feels dry.
pages.speech: Lila touched the soil gently. It felt dry. She fetched her little watering can. Plants need water, but not a great big flood.
pages.art: Same fairy kneels beside dry soil and pink flower, blue tiny watering can.

pages.title: A little drink
pages.caption: Pour slowly around the roots.
pages.speech: Drip, drop, drip. Lila poured a little water around the roots. A ladybird rested on a leaf and watched the droplets shine.
pages.art: Fairy pours small water droplets at flower roots, red ladybird on leaf, morning light.

pages.title: Make room for light
pages.caption: Leaves reach toward the sunshine.
pages.speech: A fallen leaf was covering the small plant. Lila moved it aside. Now the green leaves could reach toward the warm sunshine.
pages.art: Fairy lifts fallen leaf from young flower, warm sun reaches leaves, ladybird nearby.

pages.title: Waiting is part of growing
pages.caption: Good things take time.
pages.speech: Lila waited. She watched the clouds and listened to the garden. Growing takes time. She could care for the flower without hurrying it.
pages.art: Fairy sits on smooth stone beside recovering flower, soft clouds and calm garden.

pages.title: A visitor arrives
pages.caption: A butterfly finds the flower.
pages.speech: On another morning, the flower stood taller. A butterfly fluttered by. It settled for a moment, then danced away between the leaves.
pages.art: Upright pink flower, yellow butterfly lands gently, fairy watches smiling.

pages.title: The garden surprise
pages.caption: A new little bud!
pages.speech: Look! A new little bud had appeared. Lila smiled. Water, light, and patient care had helped the garden grow. What a lovely surprise.
pages.art: Fairy discovers tiny new closed pink bud beside open flower, blue watering can, ladybird.

pages.title: A place to share
pages.caption: Who might visit next?
pages.speech: Lila left room for all her garden visitors. The flower, the butterfly, and the tiny ladybird each belonged. Who might visit your garden?
pages.art: Thriving flower patch, fairy butterfly ladybird and snail together, inviting warm illustrated garden.

notes: Original story and illustrations; all family profiles can read it.
